modalities.evidence: using a mobile ECG and accelerometer (Bittium Faros 180)

output.population: 15 subjects (9 female, 6 male) aged between 21 to 83 years
output.summary: Long-term single-lead ECG and accelerometer recordings collected during free-living conditions, annotated for signal quality in classes, intended for development and objective comparison of ECG quality assessment algorithms.
